propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields for maint-lane findings, preventing tests findings from reaching blocking threshold despite verifiers already rating guarded-path user reach

Commit 8eadb4fbc5 shipped contradictory contract (stale>0 allowed) and test assertion (stale=0 forbidden) that code-v3 gate missed because the reachable_path binary scored ~0.30 under churn dampening (×0.5) rather than reflecting actual user-reach severity

Code-v4 redesign must split maint lane into serious (undamped ×1.0), moderate (prod_impact-keyed ×0.6–1.0), and debt (churn amplifier-only ×1.0–1.5) to elevate load-bearing findings while keeping internal edges advisory

New forbids_contract_allowed_state binary must detect tests assertions that forbid a state the same diff's contract declares allowed, with both-halves-verbatim evidence and guard excluding deliberate tightening

Tests findings must flip from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 in criteria_routing.json once impact_code implements lane split and prod_impact rescoping codifies user-reach keying for coverage/contract findings

Replay on code-v3 corpus (1881 sidecars, 1243 changes) must show v4+tests@0.54 blocks 99 changes (8.0%, operator-accepted) with zero demotions and prod=none/low mass remaining advisory, while fire case and stated-tightening pass cases validate new binary and guards
